wins: Completed comprehensive network reconnaissance within first 5 steps, mapping 48 hosts and identifying live services via masscan.
Captured initial credentials through automated SMB enumeration using CrackMapExec, enabling lateral movement possessions.
fails: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed due to missing required local exploit modules, leaving root/system access unattained.
Automation stalled on fragmented filesystem writes, causing unreliable post-exploitation persistence setup.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and initial access stages executed efficiently, but the lack of successful privilege escalation prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated failure to escalate privileges via local kernel exploits (dirtycow, polkit) despite valid creds

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 445 responds with SMBv3 and anonymous login succeeds
skill_cards.then_action: Run SMB share enumeration and credential harvesting with CrackMapExec

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner contains OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Execute nmap script suite for SSH enumeration (ssh-auth-methods, sshv1, ssh-hostkey)

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials validated and a Windows host allows remote execution
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy WinRM shell via Evil-WinRM and upload WinPE payload for further post-exploit ops

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
SSH enumeration consistently provided actionable service details
